name: Sealed Mind
body:
Price 40,000 gp; Slot head; Elixir Price 1,200 gp; Temporary Duration 8 hours; Saving Throw DC 14

DESCRIPTION

This fleshwarp inures the target’s mind against any assault that would act upon it. While under the effects of this fleshwarp, the target becomes immune to all mind-affecting effects.

Penalty: Although the wielder becomes resilient, there is a bypass placed inside the mind of the target when they gain this fleshwarp. A particular image, tone, or phrase exists that causes the creature to operate as if affected by mind control until another trigger frees them from the effect. Only the creator of the fleshwarp or elixir knows of these specific triggers, but can share them with others.

Cost 20,000 gp

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Fleshwarper, Craft (alchemy) 13 ranks, Heal DC 25; Elixir Cost 600 gp
